profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Motivated to always improve and learn
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer with over 7 years of experience designing and scaling distributed backend systems that power critical user experiences. I specialize in Java, Kotlin, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and cloud-native architectures (Docker, Kubernetes), and I’m passionate about building systems that are resilient, scalable, and highly performant.

At Target, I’ve led major initiatives to re-architect distributed supply chain systems and optimize metrics processing pipelines using event-driven designs with RocksDB, Postgres, and Kafka. I focus on improving both system throughput and developer productivity, integrating tools like SonarQube, Detekt, and JMH Benchmarking to drive high engineering standards and better CI/CD practices.

Beyond engineering scalable services, I prioritize knowledge sharing, system documentation, and cross-functional collaboration with product and platform teams. My goal is always to deliver backend platforms that not only perform at scale but also empower others to build effectively on top of them.

I'm especially motivated by roles where backend platform engineering, system design, distributed systems, and code quality converge — and I’m excited to continue growing in dynamic, high-impact environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Focused on backend resiliency, data consistency, and throughput optimization to support high-volume commerce operations
• Redesigning a metrics processing architecture using Kafka, Postgres, RocksDB, and Kotlin (coroutines), optimizing system performance and memory usage while enhancing scalability and system resilience
• Integrating code quality and performance profiling tools such as SonarQube, Detekt, and JMH Benchmark into CI/CD pipelines (built with Jenkins), improving code maintainability and service performance across multiple teams
• Addressed performance bottlenecks through tuning of HTTP services, concurrency constructs, and caching strategies, resulting in improved system response times under high load
• Leading initiatives to improve engineering quality standards through the adoption of SonarQube, Detekt, and JMH Benchmarking into CI/CD pipelines
• Designed and developed a distributed, event-driven supply chain platform using Kotlin, Kafka, RocksDB, Docker, and PostgreSQL to improve system scalability and performance
• Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, platform teams, and engineers to optimize onboarding systems and streamline operational workflows
• Introduced GraphQL APIs to modernize data delivery, improving payload efficiency and API usability across backend services
• Authored comprehensive technical documentation for legacy rewrites and new system components, improving knowledge transfer, issue resolution, and onboarding efficiency.
• Improved team cohesion by sharing experiences and understanding of the Agile methodology and challenging the team with improvements, such as teaching the features of Jira, communicating at-risk items, and defining milestones
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Kotlin · Distributed Systems · Scalability · Microservices

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer and Product Lead
positions.description:
• Led a team of 7 engineers delivering backend services for a large-scale maintenance management system using Java, MongoDB, Oracle SQL, REST APIs, and gRPC
• Designed and implemented a user-critical alerts system, improving operational response times and saving over 400 labor hours annually
• Played a key role in implementing and designing a new data analysis application by introducing MongoDB, assisting with introducing gRPC for service communication, and setting up the configuration to deploy on a Windows and Linux operating system, and OpenShift container platform
• Introduced React, Docker, and REST API technologies to modernize legacy platforms
• Facilitated a Scrum team to meet our 2-week Sprint commitments by observing and aiding Agile Scrum meetings, resolving impediments and team conflicts, and ensuring the team is on schedule for numerous baseline releases 
• Investigated and fixed defects for a flight simulator to ensure the environmental entities behaved realistically and accurate according to the pilot’s plan using C++, SQL, and other tools
• Exceeded expectations every year to date, according to performance reviews, and rewarded with recognition awards by management and the VP of the program for my contributions to the program and being an example of our sector’s cultural imperatives in 2020
• Nominated by Lockheed Martin for the 2019 HENAAC Most Promising Engineer and won an internal award for 2019 HOLA’s Most Promising Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Project Management · Java · Agile Methodologies · Microservices

positions.title: Information Technology Intern (Java)
positions.description:
• Developed Java applications for data scraping and automation, processing over 3 million Florida property records to optimize underwriting
• Assisted in building a company intranet and automated email response systems for internal communications

positions.title: Home Theater Specialist
positions.description:
• Delivered top-performing sales and customer experience in consumer electronics, exceeding revenue targets and recognized by district leadership.
• Led peer training sessions on SONY product lines to drive profitability across store departments
• Received an award for achieving top performer for 3 months in a row by having the highest revenue in the store after only a month’s worth of experience on the floor
• Recognized by district managers for selling $212,000 in one month when the average revenue of a Home Theater Sales Consultant was near half

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship (C#)
positions.description:
• Delivered full software project lifecycle work (requirements gathering through testing) within a Waterfall SDLC
• Developed and demoed custom software tools to leadership, rapidly adapting to new languages and quality processes (CMMI frameworks)
